headline: State Minister Ishrak execution of Sheikh Hasina will be carried out after genocide trial
summary: The State Minister stated that the former Prime Minister will face justice for alleged genocide, ensuring that the legal process will be followed.
details: State Minister Ishrak Ahmed is asserting that former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will face the consequences of her actions through a legal trial for genocide.
He emphasized that the legal process will be ensure that the execution of the sentence will be carried out if found guilty of genocide.
The statement comes amidst ongoing legal proceedings and investigations into the alleged mass killings during the recent political upheaval in Bangladesh.
The government's stance is the pursuit of justice for the victims and their families, ensuring that no one is above the law regardless of their former position.
